frequency_question: What proportion of submitted nuclear cooperation agreements face a successfully passed joint resolution of disapproval?
membership_rule: Includes any formal peaceful nuclear cooperation agreement (Section 123 agreements) transmitted for the statutory 90-day continuous session review period; excludes informal consultations or agreements not formally submitted.
provenance_note: claims 35 cases from only 3 named (11.7x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 3 major recent contested cases named; dozens of non-controversial agreements pass tacitly without floor action in total.
known_gaps: Historical baseline is heavily weighted toward tacit approval due to high procedural hurdles for enacting a joint resolution over a presidential veto.
skeleton: Total formal 123 agreements submitted to Congress historically divided into those that faced active resolutions of disapproval that cleared both chambers versus those that lapsed or were sustained.
multiplier: 0 successful blocks out of approximately 30+ transmitted agreements over the decades.
validity_reason: The statutory framework under the Atomic Energy Act governing congressional review of 123 agreements remains stable across administrations.
